memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been having sudden spinning sensations when I lie down or turn my head, lasting less than a minute. I also feel thirsty and need to urinate often. My asthma is usually okay with my inhaler.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Allergy: house dust mite – sneezing, nasal congestion, itchy eyes on exposure. No asthma exacerbation noted.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, reports occasional vertigo episodes, able to perform household chores.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 sec (normal).
medicines: 7 regular (betahistine, metformin, glimepiride, sitagliptin, empagliflozin, budesonide-formoterol, montelukast) – polypharmacy, review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: reports low mood related to vertigo, denies hopelessness.
carers: mother, Mrs. Lakshmi Kulkarni.
goals: "I want to control my vertigo and diabetes so I can manage my home and study."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: betahistine 16 mg BD; meclizine 25 mg SOS; metformin 500 mg BD; glimepiride 1 mg OD; sitagliptin 100 mg OD; empagliflozin 10 mg OD; salbutamol MDI SOS; budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD; montelukast 10 mg HS.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 7.8%; FPG 152 mg/dL; urine ACR 22 mg/g (mildly increased). Reference: HbA1c <5.7%; FPG 70-99; ACR <30.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: vertigo frequency reduced after betahistine, able to climb stairs without dyspnea.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (stable).
falls: 0 falls, gait steady, TUG 9 sec.
medicines: 7 regular – polypharmacy, continue review.
mood: improved, occasional frustration.
carers: mother, Mrs. Lakshmi Kulkarni.
goals: "I’d like fewer dizzy spells and steadier sugar levels."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: metformin increased to 850 mg BD; glimepiride unchanged; sitagliptin unchanged; empagliflozin unchanged; betahistine unchanged; budesonide-formoterol unchanged; montelukast unchanged; salbutamol SOS; meclizine SOS.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (85% predicted), FVC 3.2 L (88%), FEV1/FVC 0.88. Post‑bronchodilator FEV1 ↑12% – reversible obstruction consistent with asthma. Asthma Control Test score 19/25 (well‑controlled).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports no vertigo for 4 weeks, able to do light exercise.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5.
falls: 0 falls, gait normal, TUG 9 sec.
medicines: 7 regular – polypharmacy, medication review pending.
mood: good, energetic.
carers: mother, Mrs. Lakshmi Kulkarni.
goals: "I want to stay vertigo‑free and keep my diabetes under control."

memories.text:
